name: Advent: Dawn
detailed_description:
“There’s no signal. No escape. Something down here stirs... And one of us is certainly lying...”

In the year 2066, what was supposed to be a routine research expedition on a remote island turns into a nightmare. An unexpected collapse traps you deep underground with six others—but something about this place isn’t natural. What begins as a struggle for survival soon twists into something stranger. Whispers echo in the dark, and as suspicion spreads, questions mount: Who can you trust? Why does the cave feel... alive? And was this truly an accident?

Advent: Dawn is an emotive sci-fi mystery visual novel that weaves psychological suspense, emotional storytelling, and mythological undertones into a branching narrative with multiple endings. Inspired by genre classics like Zero Escape, Ever17, and Steins;Gate, this is a story-first experience designed for fans of gripping plots, high emotions and thought-provoking twists. Wishlist now and join us on the Discord link below for updates leading to release.

FEATURES:

  • Multi-route Structure: Your decisions guide the story, unlocking branching routes and multiple outcomes—all leading toward a climactic "True Ending."

  • Interactive Flowchart: Includes an interactive flowchart "map" that helps you revisit your choices to work your way through the cave and character routes.

  • Occasional Puzzles: Solve light puzzles woven into the environment and narrative to enhance tension and immersion.

  • Voice Acting: Partially voiced with optional voice-blip effects to accompany unvoiced lines, all synced with mouth animations for added immersion. Voice acting and voice-blips can be toggled and adjusted separately in the preferences menu.

  • Original Soundtrack: A fully original soundtrack from composer 'Caleb Coles'.

  • Mystery, Myth, Murder & Mind Games: Themes of identity, memory, and ancient symbolism are fused with a suspenseful sci-fi survival / murder mystery story.

  • Length: Standard read: 12-16hrs. Methodical read: 16-22hrs. Speed read: 9-12hrs.

Whether you're here for the heart, the tension, or the high-concept twists, Advent: Dawn invites you to descend—and decide.

WISHLIST NOW! Releasing late 2025 / early 2026.


*Developer's Note: Advent: Dawn is set in the same universe as The VII Enigma, but it is a standalone title—you don’t need to have played the previous game to enjoy this one. That said, fans of our earlier games can expect some tie-ins and Easter eggs along the way.

short_description: A research trip turns deadly when seven strangers are trapped in a vast cave beneath a remote island. 『Advent: Dawn』 is a sci-fi mystery visual novel where you must escape through fear, fractured trust, and whispers from the deep. Will you unravel the mystery before the cave unravels you?
